informal_statement: Issue #213: the observational record of two-body histories (joint closure tests with phase, equivalently the joint fold) does not return the territory's own event predicate, ZFA. The gauge twist + folds to I and is observationally equivalent to the empty history, which alone is ZFA. The integer ledger returns ZFA. 'Map = territory' is therefore not closed by any fold-based map; it needs a ledger-reading apparatus.

approximation_or_regime.name: Two-body observational quotient
approximation_or_regime.description: Words over the 16 tokens (body, twist), all of length <= 4; record = foldA (x) foldB; ZFA = each projection count-balanced; ledger = per-body twist counts.
approximation_or_regime.validity_limits: Two bodies, finite words; the fold record is the whole tensor/Hilbert map of QLF_TensorFromClosure. No physical apparatus for the ledger is identified.

formal_statement.statement_scope: ZFA is not a function of observational equivalence; neither closureTests nor foldPair reconstructs it; the ledger, alone or with closureTests, does. The Klein-class description of the 64 classes is numerical.

formal_object.type: reconstruction of a predicate from a record map

strange_loop.conservative_return: Fails through the observational record: + and [] share a record and differ in ZFA (zfa_not_reconstructible). Succeeds through the integer ledger (ledger_returns_zfa), which is a record the fold does not contain.
strange_loop.noncircularity_witness: The verdict rule was pre-registered and the failing witness is a single token; the ledger return is structural and claimed only as such.
strange_loop.first_order_note: F: QLF_TerritoryReturn anchors. N: territory_return.py, exhaustive to length 4.
strange_loop.defeater: A physical apparatus model whose records are exactly joint closure phases and which nevertheless separates + from the empty history; or a ledger apparatus whose records are not ZFA-faithful.
